STEP 1 - Scene: lunch plate, Caesar-style salad with croutons, grilled/breaded meat strips, and a slice of pepperoni pizza.

STEP 2 - Vessel: white square dinner plate ~26 cm side; area ≈ 26 x 26 x 0.8 ≈ 540 cm^2 (use 3.14 x 13^2 = 531 cm^2)

STEP 3 - Items:
- Caesar salad greens (romaine with dressing)
- Croutons
- Cooked meat strips (chicken/pork, breaded)
- Pepperoni pizza slices (2 pieces, partly on plate edge)
- Creamy dressing sheen

STEP 4 - Area:
- Salad greens: 35% = 186 cm^2
- Croutons: 3% = 16 cm^2
- Meat strips: 18% = 96 cm^2
- Pizza: 17% = 90 cm^2
- Dressing: 2% = 11 cm^2
- Total covered: 75% = 399 cm^2

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Salad: 186 x 3 = 558 ml
- Croutons: 16 x 1.5 = 24 ml
- Meat: 96 x 1.5 = 144 ml
- Pizza: 90 x 1.2 = 108 ml
- Dressing: 11 x 0.3 = 3 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Salad: 558 x 0.15 = 84 g
- Croutons: 24 x 0.3 = 7 g
- Meat: 144 x 0.95 = 137 g
- Pizza: 108 x 0.9 = 97 g
- Dressing: 3 x 1.0 = 3 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Salad greens w/ dressing: 84 g x 45 kcal/100g = 38 kcal (dressing-coated Caesar)
- Croutons: 7 g x 400 = 28 kcal
- Meat strips: 137 g x 230 = 315 kcal
- Pizza: 97 g x 270 = 262 kcal
- Dressing: 3 g x 480 = 14 kcal
- Total: 328 g, 657 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: 328 g across a three-quarters-covered dinner plate with a meat portion and two pizza slices is plausible.
